title: TRAVLR: Now You See It, Now You Don't! A Bimodal Dataset for Evaluating Visio-Linguistic Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models across unimodal (image-only, caption-only) and bimodal (image+caption) settings, and utilizing modal dropout during training, to measure over-reliance on the textual modality (textual bias) over visual inputs.

Creating synthetic datasets with strict out-of-distribution (OOD) test splits constrained along task-relevant dimensions (e.g., specific object counts or spatial coordinates) to prevent models from exploiting statistical correlations or memorizing the training distribution.
